as_told.title: Tic Tac is Lockheed Martin technology

related.note: Same 2004 Nimitz Tic Tac that Fravor saw, but Greer says it was a Lockheed Skunk Works craft, not a non-human object that seemed conscious.

plain: The Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint that Navy pilots met off California in 2004, is said to have been a human-made craft. On this telling, it came from Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design unit of the arms maker Lockheed. A guest named Steven Greer says he told this to David Fravor, the Navy commander who saw the object, some years ago. In his account, Fravor said it "had to be alien," and Greer replied, "Sir, with all due respect, that was how the Lockheed skunk works." Greer adds that such craft are kept hidden on purpose, because the builders "don't want the National Military Command structure to know" that something like what Fravor met "was ours." The journalist Ross Coulthart, without naming a source or mentioning Greer or Fravor, says, "I now know categorically that the Tic Tac is Lockheed Martin technology." If they are right, the most famous Navy sighting was a secret American aircraft.
